facts.text: The university was established in 1904 by Dr. Mary McLeod Bethune with five students and $1.50.

sources.title: About - B-CU Global - Bethune-Cookman University
sources.quote: In 1904, Dr. Mary McLeod Bethune opened a school with five students, $1.50, and an unshakeable belief that every person deserves access to transformative education.
